character: Controversial brutalist architecture by Marcel Breuer (Bauhaus). Open-air museum with Dubuffet, Picasso, Vasarely. 2,000 m² aquatic centre. Best snow record in the Grand Massif.
description: Flaine is the most controversial-looking resort in the Alps — designed by Marcel Breuer in the brutalist style, all concrete. Love it or hate it, it works brilliantly as a ski resort: car-free, ski-in/ski-out, excellent snow at 1,600-2,500m. Best value in the Grand Massif (265km). The pedestrian square features a massive sculpture by Jean Dubuffet (Le Boiscour). Good for families, budget skiers, and intermediates.

non_ski_activities.aquatic_centre: 2,000 m² — 25 m pool, children's pool, 2 hot tubs, 2 saunas, 2 steam baths, fitness centre, massage. Open 10am-8pm. Located in Le Centaure residence, Flaine Forum.
spas: RockyPop Flaine — Spa Nuxe, 400 sqm, pool, Kneipp path, sauna, hammam
Totem Spa (Totem Hotel) — 3 cabins, Pure Altitude treatments, 2 saunas, relaxation area, jacuzzi terrace, fitness, yoga
Deep Nature Spa (Les Terrasses d'Hélios) — sauna, hammam, Norwegian shower
Spa Montagnes du Monde (Alhéna Hotel) — heated indoor pool, sauna, hammam, whirlpool, Nordic bath
non_ski_activities.art: Open-air museum: Jean Dubuffet 'Le Boqueteau', Pablo Picasso 'Tête de Femme', Victor Vasarely 'Les Trois Hexagones', Pol Bury fountain in Auditorium. Ecumenical Chapel listed as Historic Monument since 2014. Guided art tours available.
non_ski_activities.architecture: Designed by Marcel Breuer (Bauhaus). Brutalist concrete with diamond-point facades. Listed in French Historical Monuments Survey (1991). 'Architectural Heritage of the 20th Century' label (2008). First 8-seater high-speed chairlift in Europe. First snow cannons in Europe.
non_ski_activities.other: Ice driving circuit, big air bag, snow kite, snowmobiling, natural ice rink, bowling, cinema, classical music concerts

honest_drawbacks: Brutalist architecture — strongly disliked by many

restaurants: La Pente à Jules (piste-side, relaxed, local flavours, sunny terrace)
RockyPop Flaine — Buffet, Frometon (Savoyard), Sushi House, Brasserie Les Cimes
Le Bissac (bar, self-service, restaurant, non-stop snacking)
Les Chalets du Michet (refined inventive cuisine in 100-year-old sheepfold)
Le Bauhaus (bar & restaurant, Savoyard inspiration, seafood, grilled meats)
Le Désert Blanc (2,500 m panoramic terrace, Mont Blanc views)
